text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
Hello! It's that time again—
time for "URA Pakatto Radio".

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: —With Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross leading the way, promising newcomers are bursting onto the racing scene one after another.

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: I've suddenly become very excited for next year's Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: Looking back, so many Umamusume have brought excitement to the Japanese racing world lately, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B., the first Triple Crown Umamusume in over a decade.
Katsuragi Ace, the first Japanese Umamusume to conquer the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf took the world by storm
as the first undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume in domestic history.

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: Likewise, the peerless gem of an Umamusume who achieved the first-ever Triple Tiara: Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
"And above all else,
we must never forget our monumental milestone—"

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that the day for her
to depart for Europe is drawing near, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahh!
Take care, Sirius-senpai~!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Don't make such a fuss. It's only been two years, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Two whole years!? That's way too long~!
I was cheering you on, but now that it's here, I'm gonna miss you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text: "N-No, guys...! We need to properly support Sirius-senpai's dream...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha.
You really are adored by your juniors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Take care of yourself in Europe.
If anything happens, you can contact me anytime."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sorry to have Dad and the others go through the trouble. Once you arrive, give me a call—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yo.
...Well, the least I could do is see you off.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Go out and have fun, your way.
And... send some news from the outside once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh? You got interested in the outside world too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess that depends on how well you do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry for catching you while you're busy.
I'm glad I could see you before I left.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just one last look at least, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...How very polite of both of you to show up together.
Does everyone around here have nothing better to do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will miss you.
However, my expectations for you are equally high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Shine brighter than anyone and illuminate us. I pray for beautiful days for you in Europe."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Siriuuus!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, made it in time!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was out running and got totally lost.
I was worried what would happen for a second there.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Hold your head high and give it your all over there too!
Your racing will definitely measure up, no doubt about it!”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. ...If I get jealous,
I might just end up chasing after them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...
Thanks for your hard work too, guys.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...What's the matter? You're unusually hesitant.

Setting aside the juniors and the fathers...
Seeing so many Umamusume gathered, I was left stunned, when—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Fans
text_block_list.text: Siriuuus--!!
Looking toward the voice... I saw a group of what looked like fans, waving with a banner in hand.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Fan A
text_block_list.text: Do your best in Europe too!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You can do it!
Go show them what a Japanese Umamusume is made of~!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
Look at you, quite the fan favorite, aren't ya?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I intended to depart quietly, but my plan fell apart completely.

Passionate cheers rained down one after another—
everyone was celebrating her maiden voyage.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, guess it can't be helped.

Sirius Symboli let out a breath
and locked eyes with them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hey, you guys!
The sharp voice tightened the atmosphere of the room.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I hear ya loud and clear.
—But this is only just the beginnin'."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sit like a good girl and wait nicely.
...I promise I'll show you something amazing.

Surrounded by an explosion of cheers,
Sirius Symboli boarded the plane
without looking back.

The wheels spun, the craft lifted off—
and soon, she soared into the vast sky.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will a champion of Japan finally be born this year?!
Just who will be the Umamusume to forge a new legend?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, it begins—the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
Envisioning such a future.
